title: Stillness
summary: Takemura proposes a silence contest on a Wellsprings promenade bench, where the one who speaks first buys the tea.

start.bringUp: Takemura proposes a contest: the one who speaks first loses, and the loser buys tea.

g1.asks: What did you think about, in the silence?
g1.know: The silence contest has ended, and a street performer has just bowed and left.
g1.secret: He thought of Chiba-11 and the canal.

variations.know: The silence will last longer than any before it.
variations.wants: V to keep quiet until the end.

variations.know: The promenade is loud, and the silence is harder to keep.
variations.wants: V to hold the silence through the noise.

variations.know: V is allowed one word before the silence starts.
variations.wants: V to choose the word carefully.

stages.label: V and Takemura sit in silence on the promenade
stages.know: You are on a promenade bench in Wellsprings with Takemura. You are keeping a silence, and a street performer is trying to make you both laugh.
stages.wants: V to keep the silence and not speak first.

done.memory: You and Takemura sat on a Wellsprings bench for ten minutes without a word, and he did not move while a street performer tried to make him laugh.

stood-up.memory: You did not come to the promenade, and Takemura sat on the bench in silence until he gave up.
